attributes.title: Orders
attributes.description: Total orders in the selected time range (orders.processed counter). Source: orders.processed (counter), field value.

attributes.title: Error rate
attributes.description: Share of order.process calls that ended in error. filter_ratio = errors / calls. Source: app.function.duration (histogram), field count, function=order.process.

attributes.title: p95 order latency
attributes.description: 95% of orders complete faster than this. Estimated from the histogram buckets of app.function.duration (precision = bucket width). Source: app.function.duration (histogram), bucket counts.

attributes.title: Revenue lost (USD)
attributes.description: Value of orders that failed. This is what an incident costs. Source: orders.value (histogram), field sum.

attributes.title: Orders per interval: success vs failed
Order latency: p50 / p95 / p99
attributes.description: Percentiles estimated from the app.function.duration histogram: bucket counts are summed per time bucket by a scripted_metric aggregation, then interpolated. Source: app.function.duration (histogram), bucket counts.

attributes.title: Orders in flight
attributes.description: Gauge-like (cumulative up/down counter): each document holds the current value. Source: app.function.active (up/down counter), field value.

attributes.title: p95 latency by pipeline step
attributes.description: One histogram, split by function inside the script. Source: app.function.duration (histogram), bucket counts.

attributes.title: Order latency distribution
attributes.description: Each column is a time bucket; each cell counts the orders that fell in that latency bucket. A second band appearing = a population of slow orders. Source: app.function.duration (histogram), bucket counts.

attributes.title: Per-function RED table
attributes.description: Rows = function x outcome. Calls = sum(count), Total seconds = sum(sum) of app.function.duration. Source: app.function.duration (histogram), fields count and sum.

attributes.title: Failed steps (click a traceId, then open it in Trace analytics)
Revenue vs revenue lost
attributes.description: Source: orders.value (histogram), field sum, split by outcome.

attributes.visState: {"title":"How to read this dashboard","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":true,"markdown":"**Read it top to bottom, it follows how you investigate an incident.** 1) *Golden signals*: is something wrong? 2) *Where is it slow*: which step? 3) *Why is it failing*: which error, which trace? 4) *Business impact*: what did it cost? 5) *Logs*: what did the code say?  \nSet the time range (top right) to cover your load run; during the staged incident (40-65% of the run) payments get ~700 ms slower and decline ~35% of cards. Jump from any `traceId` to the full waterfall under **Observability -> Trace analytics**."}}
